intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Greensboro for 2026, and here is what he found: 22 family events, at least 3 of them free. The new listings run from December 3 (Meet Santa at Benjamin Branch Library) through December 24 (Cirque Dreams Holidaze), with Christmas at the Carolina (December 5), the McLaurin Farms Christmas Festival (December 10 to 23) and Gibsonville's market and parade (December 5 and 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Greensboro

  • 22 Christmas events for kids in Greensboro (17 already live plus 5 new)
  • At least 3 free events, including Christmas at the Carolina (December 5), Meet Santa at Benjamin Branch Library (December 3) and the Holiday Parade
  • Meet Santa: Meet Santa at Benjamin Branch Library (December 3), Christmas at the Carolina with Mr. and Mrs. Claus (December 5) and the Gibsonville Christmas Market (December 5)
  • Parades and shows: Cirque Dreams Holidaze at the Steven Tanger Center (December 23 and 24) and the Gibsonville Christmas Parade (December 12)
  • Farm lights: McLaurin Farms Christmas Festival (December 10 to 23)
  • New listings run from December 3 to December 24

Planning a bigger day out? Greensboro families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in High Point, which covers Winter Glow at the Point, Winter WonderPark and A Christmas Carol The Musical.
